_help_: cmake-format / cmake-lint configuration. JSON because the precommit
env that runs cmake-format ships without PyYAML, so YAML configs are
skipped silently and our settings would not apply. Layout is owned
by cmake-format (auto-applied via the pre-commit hook); cmake-lint's
Convention-level checks listed under disabled_codes below conflict
with that layout or with our chosen conventions and are silenced
deliberately rather than papering over each occurrence with an
C0103 - variable names with leading underscore. We use `_foo` to
mark function-local sets that should not leak; the
cmake-lint default regex disallows the leading underscore.
C0111 - missing docstrings on every function/macro. Helpers are
short, self-documenting via filename + leading file comment.
C0301 - line length > 80. Repo-wide column limit is 100
C0307 - indentation level. cmake-format owns layout; if
cmake-format and cmake-lint disagree, cmake-format wins.
